observation: I have been counting the dead we pass. It is not the same men doing the dying each week -- the factions are eating their own recruits faster than they can raise them. Whatever is out here, it is grinding them down, and nobody at the fort will say the word for it.
request: You have one pair of hands and so do I. Tell me whether we spend the next stretch getting strong or getting clear, because we cannot do both.

interpretations.claim: We dig in. Build here, take what the wreck still owes us, and be the thing that is still standing when they have finished each other off.
We stay light and stay moving. Anything we build is something we have to defend, and I would rather be somewhere else when it comes for us.

observation: The low channels east of the shrine have gone brackish in eleven days. Not drying -- turning. I have the dates and I have the taste of it, and I would rather be wrong in front of you than quiet in front of them.
request: I want to know whether we treat this as their doing or as the island's. Say which, and I will spend my time accordingly.

interpretations.claim: They are doing it on purpose, and the water is the shape of how far they have got. If that is right, the spread is a map of their reach and we should be reading it as intelligence.
It is the island answering something, not a hand on a tap. If that is right, chasing the cult past the water wastes the little time we have, and I should be mapping the ground itself instead.

observation: The grove people are gone. Not driven off -- gone, and the ground where they stood is still standing. I walked the edge of it this morning and there was no one to tell me to leave, and I did not like how that felt.
request: Somebody will take that ground. Tell me whether we are somebody, or whether we are the ones who stay off it.

interpretations.claim: We take it. It is good ground, it is empty, and whoever walks onto it next will not ask our permission to be there.
We leave it. A faction died on that ground within a fortnight of holding it, and I would rather learn what killed them than stand where they stood.

observation: There are four of us behind you now, and we have never once been told what we are. A crew has a job. A household has a roof. We have a beach and a man with a plan he has not said out loud.
request: Say what we are for. I am not asking you to be kind about it -- I am asking so the four of us stop guessing differently.

interpretations.claim: A crew. We are here to get off this island with everything we can carry, and everything else is means to that.
A household. We are here because there is nowhere else, and what we build we are going to have to live in.

observation: The shed has grown twice now and the things that come out of it walk on their own. The others have stopped flinching at them, which worries me more than the flinching did.
request: I want to know what you think you are making in there, because I have to stand next to it.

interpretations.claim: Tools. They do what I built them to do and nothing else, and the day one surprises me I will take it apart on the beach.
Crew. I am not going to pretend otherwise to make it easier. They stand where a person would have to stand, and that is the whole reason I built them.

observation: Six weeks. I have started counting in weeks, which I did not do at first. The fighting out there has a rhythm to it now, and a rhythm means somebody is keeping time.
request: Tell me whether we are waiting for something or hiding from something, because I am doing one of them and I would like to know which.

interpretations.claim: Waiting. Whatever is under that water is on a schedule, and when it comes up I want us standing somewhere we chose.
Hiding, and I will not dress it up. Every faction that made itself visible on this island is smaller than it was. We are still here because nobody has needed to come and find us.

observation: It knows. I do not have a better word and I am not going to look for one. The weather turned the wrong way round the headland and every dog on this island stopped barking at the same hour.
request: Whatever we do next we do together or not at all. Say it plain: do we go and meet it, or do we make it come to us?

interpretations.claim: We go to it. On its ground, on our feet, while we still have the choosing of the hour.
We make it come here. Everything we have built is here, and I would rather spend it than leave it behind for the sake of a shorter walk.
